in_marathi.name: Hemashree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘hema’ meaning gold and ‘shree’ meaning prosperity. Hemashree is the goddess of earth and symbolizes fertility, growth, and prosperity.

vedic_reference.note: The name Hemashree is derived from the Sanskrit words 'हेम' (hem) and 'श्री' (shree), which respectively mean 'wealth, prosperity' and 'goddess of fortune, prosperity'. This name is believed to bring good fortune and happiness to the one who bears it.
